facts.fact: Matteo 在潜水器奇迹般轻缓停住约半小时后，再次徒劳地尝试发送求救信号
facts.anchor: Matteo started vainly trying to send distress signals again

facts.fact: Jelka 指出此举毫无意义，因为她们正身处唯一能下潜到此深度的船上
facts.anchor: there was little to no sense in doing this, since we were on board the only vessel capable of diving to such a depth

facts.fact: Jelka 讽刺说难道上面会派搜救队下到一万英尺、再扔绳梯走完剩下的路
facts.anchor: send a search party ten thousand feet then throw a rope ladder the rest of the way?

facts.fact: Leah 记得 Jelka 瞪着她们，瘦得几乎不成人形却还能走动
facts.anchor: I remember her then, glaring at us, as thin as I have ever known a person to be and still be able to move around

facts.fact: 无人评论处境的诡异，正如坠落时那样，质疑的冲动被奇怪地压平了
facts.anchor: the impulse to question felt curiously flattened

facts.fact: Leah 又短暂闻到烧焦的人肉味，想说点什么，却用海面之上的琐事转移了注意力
facts.anchor: I smelled burning flesh again, just for a moment, and thought about saying something

facts.fact: 举灯照向舷窗只照回自己的脸——深水中的鬼影，六只眼睛从外面窥视
facts.anchor: six eyes peering in from without

facts.fact: 系统离线，无法确知下坠了多深；Leah 几乎毫不怀疑她们已落到可能的最深处
facts.anchor: I believed almost without question that we had fallen as far as it was possible to go
